image_description: A dark grey, stocky wombat is captured in a side-profile view, foraging in tall green grass. The animal exhibits a robust, barrel-shaped body with coarse, thick fur. Its head is broad and blunt, lowered towards the ground, obscuring some facial details. Short, powerful limbs are visible, particularly the forelimb tucked under the chest. The tail is not clearly visible due to the angle and vegetation.
